name: leaderboard-internet-declined
about: The player declined net.internet and allowed net.local; the server option is a host off this computer (under .invalid, which never resolves, so nothing could leave the machine if the refusal failed): the board says this mod may not reach the internet, a star's time is not sent and the line over the game says why, and the game goes on

expect.is: This mod is not allowed to reach the internet. Allow it on the mod's page in Mods.
This star's time was not sent. This mod is not allowed to reach the internet. Allow it on the mod's page in Mods.
